cohort: The study included women who underwent USgHIFU or myomectomy for uterine fibroids between January 2012 and December 2019 and subsequently conceived.
finding: Reproductive outcomes after USgHIFU were comparable to those after myomectomy, suggesting USgHIFU is a viable option for patients with fertility requirements.
mod_finding: Group A(1) (single USgHIFU ablation) showed a lower cesarean section rate (74.1% vs. 83.0%) than Group MY(1) (myomectomy), though the difference was not statistically significant.
